entities.summary: Anri Jokhadze is a Georgian pop singer, composer, music video director, TV presenter from Tbilisi, Georgia, who represented Georgia in the Eurovision Song Contest 2012 with the song "I'm a Joker". The singer is a winner and laureate of 13 international contests. Prior to his appearance at the Eurovision Song Contest 2012, Anri Jokhadze has also represented Georgia in the Eurovision Song Contest 2008 as a backing vocalist for Diana Gurtskaya and her song "Peace Will Come." He is also the composer of the Georgian entry at the Eurovision Song Contest 2017, "Keep the Faith" sung by Tamara Gachechiladze.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Anri Jokhadze's Eurovision appearances and songwriting contributions had a significant impact on Georgian popular culture, with his songs reaching millions of viewers and inspiring a new generation of artists. His work also helped to promote Georgia's cultural identity globally.
